questions.stem: Which of the following statements is false regarding the surgical anatomy of the small intestine?

options.label: A
options.text: The duodenum is demarcated from the jejunum by the ligament of Treitz.

options.label: B
options.text: The ileum makes up three-fifths of the small intestine.

options.label: C
options.text: The blood supply to the jejunum may have four or five separate arcades with shorter vasa recta

options.label: D
options.text: The jejunum has a larger circumference, is thicker than the ileum
